posts.caption:
Ocean Blue Juice Shots 🌊

1 Pineapple
3 Green apples
2 inch piece of Ginger
1 Lemon
1 Lime
16 oz coconut water 
1-2 tsp blue spirulina powder 

Remove the skin from the pineapple, lemon and lime and core the apples, then juice along with the ginger! 
To the fresh juice, add the coconut water and spirulina powder and whisk together until combined! 
This recipe makes about 50oz of juice, or 25 2oz shots🌊

The mini juice bottles are linked on my Amazon store under “Sea You Soon Baby Shower” along with everything else I used to prep for the event! 

My juicer is a @namawell J2, it’s linked in my bio and you can use code MAKAYLA10 to save🫶🏼

#juicerecipes #babyshower #pregnant
